description: README publication references; not an independent verification authority. Canonical generated docs retain their original statuses and uncommitted sentinel.
evidence_policy: source-grounded claims only; this contract grants no runtime qualification, release promotion, or verified status

claims.heading: Home — Know how your workspace is doing
claims.statement: Home shows a prepared workspace overview and safe next actions.
claims.limitation: Display does not prove backend health.

claims.heading: Devices — Bring your devices together
claims.statement: Device enrollment is backend-owned with identity guards.
claims.limitation: Supported devices and availability depend on runtime prerequisites.

claims.heading: Apps — Self-hosted applications, managed simply
claims.statement: App Catalog manages declared capabilities; PhotoPrism is the documented production adapter.
claims.limitation: No claim of general third-party app installation or branch qualification.

claims.heading: Safety — Understand your local safety posture
claims.statement: Quick, Full and supported App checks provide bounded local findings.
claims.limitation: Checks are not guarantees and may be incomplete.

claims.heading: Recovery — Prepare for the unexpected
claims.statement: Backup, verification, preview and guarded restore are modeled as distinct steps.
claims.limitation: A backup is not automatically verified; restore readiness varies.

claims.heading: Identity & Access — Decide who can do what
claims.statement: Local human access and optional Enterprise Mode are exposed.

claims.heading: Rules — Keep protected actions governed
claims.statement: Rules govern explicitly registered protected actions.
claims.limitation: Not an unrestricted rule automation engine.
